sentences.en: There is very little probability of an agreement being reached.
What is the probability of life showing up on Earth?
sentences.zh: 地球上有生命出现的概率是多少？

sentences.en: The probability that it will ever happen is vanishingly small.
sentences.zh: 它发生的概率微乎其微。

senses.zh: 可能性，或然性；可能发生的事，可能真实的事；（数）概率，几率
